import bpy,json,re
from mathutils import Vector
from pathlib import Path
c=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
groups={}
for o in c.objects:
 key=re.sub(r'\.\d+$','',o.get('source_component',o.name))
 if key not in groups:
  co=[o.matrix_world@Vector(p) for p in o.bound_box]
  groups[key]={'example':o.name,'count':0,'lo':[min(p[i] for p in co) for i in range(3)],'hi':[max(p[i] for p in co) for i in range(3)],'materials':[m.name for m in o.data.materials if m],'modifiers':[(m.type,getattr(m,'width',0)) for m in o.modifiers]}
 groups[key]['count']+=1
p=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent/'captures'/'shipyard_steel_20261111'
(p/'component_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(groups,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print('NAMESPACE',list(bpy.app.driver_namespace.get('shipyard_craft',{}).keys()))
print('AUDIT',str(p),len(c.objects))
